kashika: कर्मण्युपपदे कृञो धातोः खमुञ् प्रत्ययो भवत्याक्रोशे गम्यमाने। चोरंकारमाक्रोशति। चोरोऽसि दस्युरसीत्याक्रोशति। चोरकरणमाक्रोशसंपादनार्थमेव, न त्वसौ चोरः क्रियते॥
kashikaEnglish: खमुञ् after कृ with accusative for abuse: चोरंकारमाक्रोशति 'he reviles calling him thief'. Person not really made thief—expresses indignation.
englishFull:
आक्रोशे कृञोऽनुप्रयोगस्य खमुञ् — खमुञ् is added to कृ ("to make") when a word in the accusative is in construction, if the sense implies abuse (आक्रोश).

Of खमुञ्: the efficient portion is अम्; ख introduces augment मुम् (@ref[6.3.67]).

Example: चोरं कारमाक्रोशति — "He reviles him as a thief" (calls out "You are a thief!" in abuse).

The person isn't really made a thief — "making him a thief" expresses indignation.
